goal: Measure real ProjectKnowledgePack persistence, retrieval, cold-start, and memory scaling before deciding whether physical storage must change.
acceptance_criteria: production Knowledge and Conversation semantics remain unchanged
real filesystem save/load and new-process cold-start measurements cover 1k through 100k and 250k when resource-safe
fixed queries preserve correctness, provenance, lifecycle filtering, and cross-domain isolation
mixed workloads separate internalization, retrieval, serialization, index rebuild, and disk costs
storage alternatives are researched only after a measured persistence-locality gap
one logical ProjectKnowledgePack authority is preserved in every candidate

quality_metrics.measure: physical bytes and save wall time per logical local update
quality_metrics.target: measure slope and dominant cost without an invented product SLO
quality_metrics.method: five real single-update saves at each uniform scale

quality_metrics.measure: read, parse, rebuild, time-to-first-retrieval, time-to-first-answer, and RSS
quality_metrics.method: new-process load at every evaluated scale

quality_metrics.measure: P50/P95 latency, candidates, locality, recall, and correctness
quality_metrics.target: no false locality or quality regression
quality_metrics.method: 12 fixed query classes under uniform, hot-branch, and long-tail shape

quality_metrics.measure: 1000-operation read-heavy, balanced, and write-heavy cost composition
quality_metrics.target: all admitted runs pass within the measured runtime guard
quality_metrics.method: S0 feasibility gate and complete S2 10k/50k/100k matrix

improvement: recommend backward-compatible segmented append authority with validated derived checkpoints

interface_expectations: ProjectKnowledgePack remains the only logical knowledge authority
Conversation request/response and read-only behavior remain unchanged
research storage adapters are not production entrypoints

feedback: Correctness and restart equivalence pass through 250k, but current physical save and cold-load costs are not local.
S2 is the leading research candidate for update locality and crash recovery, but its cold replay requires validated checkpoints and compaction before production adoption.
No production storage or public persistence format changed in this iteration.

worked: separating semantic locality from persistence locality
using authority and query hashes after every process restart
using measured runtime projection to avoid hundreds of GiB of redundant S0 writes
did_not_work: the first query evaluator treated one ID as the only correct answer for intentionally equivalent ambiguous facts
the first workload trace queried lifecycle-inactive fixture IDs
experiments: S0 current monolith versus S1 chunked, S2 append authority, and S3 compact authority plus sidecar
